title: Resumed session totals are added again as invocation usage
reasoning: Trace parsing reads cumulative total_token_usage and total_cost. A retry resumes the previous session, and trace totals override invocation totals before _sync_usage adds them to previously accumulated usage. When the resumed trace remains eligible for reading, earlier usage is charged again, inflating benchmark costs and potentially triggering usage limits prematurely.
reproduction: Run an invocation whose trace reports 100 input tokens, then retry without saving artifacts between calls. Have the resumed trace report 150 cumulative input tokens. Accumulated input usage becomes 250 rather than 150.
recommendation: Track previously accounted cumulative totals per session and add only their deltas, or consistently account using invocation-local usage.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; coverage of cumulative trace accounting across retries cannot be verified.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise multiple resumed invocations with cumulative token and cost reports, asserting accumulated usage equals the latest session total and limits are evaluated against actual consumption.
minimumFixScope: CodexAgent cumulative usage accounting and retry coverage.
